spoken_text: અમારે લોગિન સ્ક્રીન પર ઈમેલ અને પાસવર્ડ બંને જોઈએ છે.
english: We need both email and password on the login screen.

spoken_text: ડેશબોર્ડ પર દરેક યુઝરની પેમેન્ટ હિસ્ટ્રી દેખાવી જોઈએ.
english: The dashboard should show every user's payment history.

spoken_text: રિપોર્ટ ડાઉનલોડ કરવાનું બટન ઉપરના જમણા ખૂણામાં રાખો.
english: Put the report download button in the top right corner.

spoken_text: એડમિન પેનલમાં બધા યુઝર્સની યાદી અને તેમનો સ્ટેટસ દેખાય.
english: The admin panel should show all users in a list with their status.

spoken_text: लॉगिन पेज पर ओटीपी वेरिफिकेशन भी होना चाहिए।
english: The login page should also have OTP verification.

spoken_text: पेमेंट गेटवे से रीफंड का ऑप्शन डायरेक्ट ऐप में दिखाना है।
english: The refund option from the payment gateway should be shown directly in the app.

spoken_text: हर ट्रांजैक्शन की डिटेल रिपोर्ट में डेट और टाइम के साथ आनी चाहिए।
english: Every transaction's details should appear in the report with date and time.

spoken_text: नोटिफिकेशन सेटिंग में यूजर खुद चुन सके कि कौन सी अलर्ट चाहिए।
english: In notification settings the user should be able to choose which alerts they want.

spoken_text: We need a dashboard that shows monthly revenue and active users.
english: We need a dashboard that shows monthly revenue and active users.

spoken_text: The admin panel should let us export the user list as a CSV file.
english: The admin panel should let us export the user list as a CSV file.

spoken_text: Please add a search bar on the orders page with filters by date.
english: Please add a search bar on the orders page with filters by date.

spoken_text: The API should support pagination for large result sets.
english: The API should support pagination for large result sets.

spoken_text: લોગિન કરતા વખતे OTP वेरिफिकेशन જોઈએ છે, वरना यूજर गलत पેमेन્ટ કરશે.
english: OTP verification is needed while logging in, otherwise the user will make wrong payments.

spoken_text: ડેશબોર્ડ पर हर यूજरनું स्कोर अને रीफंड स્ટેટસ दેખાવો.
english: Show every user's score and refund status on the dashboard.

spoken_text: રિપોર્ટ डाउनलोड करने का बटन डેશબોર્� पर ही रাখો.
english: Keep the report download button on the dashboard itself.

spoken_text: એડમિન पैनल में टीम के सब लोगोंને રोल आપવાનું આવશે.
english: The admin panel will need to let us assign roles to the whole team.

spoken_text: લોગિન સ્ક્રીન પર forgot password નો લિંક પણ રાખો.
english: Also keep a forgot password link on the login screen.

spoken_text: પેમેન્ટ કર્યા પછી confirmation email આવવો જોઈએ.
english: A confirmation email should arrive after payment.

spoken_text: ડેશબોર્ડ પર monthly revenue નો graph દેખાડો.
english: Show a graph of monthly revenue on the dashboard.

spoken_text: રિપોર્ટ માં બધા orders ની status export કરો.
english: Export the status of all orders in the report.

spoken_text: जल्दी बताइए, पेमेंट गेटवे में कौन से मोड चाहिए, UPI, कार्ड, नेट बैंकिंग तीनों, और रीफंड का स्लैब भी बता दीजिए।
english: Quickly tell me which payment gateway modes are needed, UPI, card, net banking, all three, and also tell us the refund slab.

spoken_text: ઝડપથી કહો, લોગિન માં ઈમેલ, ઓટીપી, પાસવર્ડ ત્રણેય જોઈએ છે, અને ડેશબોર્ડ પર રિપોર્ટ પણ ડાયરેક્ટ ડાઉનલોડ થવો જોઈએ.
english: Quickly, login needs email, OTP, password, all three, and the report on the dashboard should be directly downloadable too.

spoken_text: डार्क मोड भी चाहिए।
english: Dark mode is also needed.

spoken_text: બટન વાદળી રાખો.
english: Keep the button blue.

spoken_text: Rahul from Infosys approved a budget of forty five thousand rupees on August twelfth.
english: Rahul from Infosys approved a budget of forty five thousand rupees on August twelfth.

spoken_text: मीटिंग 15 अगस्त को दोपहर 3 बजे है, नेहा और आरव भी आएंगे।
english: The meeting is on August 15 at 3 in the afternoon, Neha and Aarav will also come.

spoken_text: એડમિન પેનલમાં બધા યુઝર્સની યાદી અને તેમનો સ્ટેટસ દેખાય.
english: The admin panel should show all users in a list with their status.

spoken_text: लॉगिन पेज पर ओटीपी वेरिफिकेशन भी होना चाहिए।
english: The login page should also have OTP verification.

spoken_text: રિપોર્ટ કાલે મોકલો.
english: Send the report tomorrow.

spoken_text: मीटिंग कोई नहीं छोड़ेगा।
english: No one will skip the meeting.
